text.RASTRO E LASTRO<br>PERCURSO E SUSTENTO<b:
TRACE AND GROUNDING
PATH AND SUPPORT
SOURCE AND BASIS
text.Quando só medir já não bastava: When measuring alone was no longer enough
text.O sistema entregava listas, e delas se e: The system delivered lists, and from them volume was extracted: how large the caseload, how many case events, of what kind. At first instance, that guided schedules and assigned tasks; conversion into judgments was rare, and there were no opinions to track. At the Appellate Panel, the question changed: from how much was done to how much of the work turned into a decision, orders into opinions.
text.DATA é esse exercício retrospectivo: med: DATA is that retrospective exercise: measuring with a trace, knowing where each number comes from, and interpreting with grounding, knowing what it allows us to claim.
text.A parcela de despachos convertidos em vo: The share of orders converted into opinions. An original indicator that, aligned with the CNJ’s KPI-based management (Ordinance No. 471/2025, art. 10, XI), measures the share of opinions in the total orders actually issued, distinguishing final output from intermediate output.
Where it came from and how I got here.
text.TAXA DE FINALIZAÇÃO | SETE MESES, CINCO: FINALIZATION RATE | SEVEN MONTHS, FIVE COMPARABLE
The number depends on where it is measured.
text.Cinco meses integrais entre duas bordas: Five full months between two edges that cannot be compared.
text.Novembro registra dois despachos. Maio c: November records two orders. May covers five days. Both fall within the official window and neither describes a month of operation: they appear outlined, not filled.
text.TEMPO DE FILA | DATA DESPACHO − DATA ENV: QUEUE TIME | ORDER DATE − SUBMISSION DATE
text.A média geral é um composto de dois flux: The overall average is a composite of two flows, one nearly double the other.
text.Publicar 10,1 dias seria correto e inúti: Publishing 10.1 days would be correct and useless. What the number hides is segregation: opinions and orders without an opinion are distinct work, with distinct queues, and only when separated does the measure say anything.
text.Fila média até a publicação do voto. Inc: Average queue until the opinion is published. It includes the institutional interval between finishing the work and the formal listing on the judgment agenda.
text.Despachos sem voto. Metade do tempo, sem: Orders without an opinion. Half the time, with no agenda stage and no drafting on the merits.
text.Composto dos dois fluxos: <span style=\": Composite of the two flows: 10.1 days — published only as a reference, not as an indicator.
text.CADEIA | CINCO BASES QUE NÃO SOMAM: CHAIN | FIVE BASES THAT DO NOT ADD UP
text.A operação de execuções fiscais antecede: The tax enforcement operation predates the systems and enters here as the foundation. ECHO, ATRIO, CORPUS, and CERNE belong to their own populations and periods; the values document a chain of work, not a cumulative sum.

text.Registros processuais únicos, após ident: Unique case records, after identification and deduplication. It measures the scale of the base, not decision quality.
text.Mediana por ato, da entrada do texto às: Median per ruling, from text input to questions. Time follows the number of doubts, not the length of the ruling.
text.com ponto embargável: with a point open to a motion for clarification
text.Perguntas espalhadas ao acaso pelos mesm: Questions scattered at random over the same paragraphs would hit 2.2 of the 12 corrected points. CERNE hit 7 (58.33%), plus 2 on another corroborated point.

text.A fonte original é jurimetria.xlsx, base: The original source is jurimetria.xlsx, a working base extracted from an internal system and used by the author to formulate the indicators. It is not official TJPR data, and the raw base is not part of the current public artifacts.
text.O mês é definido pela data do despacho,: The month is defined by the order date, when there is work by the legal advisor. Later review by another unit is not part of the indicator.
text.O teste com denominador bruto é exibido: The raw-denominator test is shown and rejected because it includes 135 records still without an order.
text.A verificação pública usa jurimetria_der: Public verification uses jurimetria_derivada.csv and the SHA-256 hash of the source, plus the minimal derivatives of ECHO, ATRIO, CERNE, and the tax enforcement operation (Res. 574) in assets/data/lastro. The aggregated derivatives allow the published figures to be recalculated without exposing case rows or third-party data.
text.O mês é definido pela data do despacho,: The month is defined by the order date, when the legal advisor’s work exists. Later review records a stage of another unit and is not part of the indicator. The denominator contains only the orders actually issued.
text.DECOMPOSIÇÃO DO UNIVERSO | 1.896 REGISTR: BREAKDOWN OF THE POPULATION | 1,896 ASSIGNED RECORDS
text.Publicado sobre despachos. O denominador: Published over orders. The denominator contains only the orders actually issued.
text.Teste adversarial sobre o bruto. O denom: Adversarial test on the raw figure. The denominator of 1,896 includes 135 cases assigned and not yet ruled on by order.
text.881 votos em 1.711 despachos, nos cinco: 881 opinions in 1,711 orders, over the five full months. Excluding the edges moves the result by 0.44 pp.
text.Indicador individual autônomo, publicado: A standalone individual indicator, published without any third-party productivity benchmark.
text.FUNDAMENTO DA FILA | O QUE 13,2 E 6,9 DI: BASIS OF THE QUEUE | WHAT 13.2 AND 6.9 DAYS MEASURE
text.Data Envio. Registra a chegada ao gabine: Submission Date. It records arrival at the chambers, not individual assignment to the legal advisor.
text.Data Despacho. Nos votos, associada à in: Order Date. For opinions, it is tied to the formal listing on the judgment agenda, which adds an institutional layer to the interval.
text.Votos e despachos sem voto são medidos s: Opinions and orders without an opinion are measured separately. The composite average of 10.1 days is not published as an indicator.
text.O intervalo incorpora fila da unidade so: The interval combines the unit’s queue with working time. It is not a measure of individual performance.
text.A curva de finalização coincide com a ad: The finalization curve coincides with the adoption of the system, and coincidence is not proof. There is no individual record of use, two staff members joined the payroll in March, and April had a seasonal task force.
text.Christian da Costa. Projeto autoral em c: Christian da Costa. My own project in a professional context, not official TJPR work. The original base was extracted from an internal system and contains third-party data; it is not part of the current public artifacts. Only aggregated derivatives and the source integrity hash are made available.
text.Rastro para saber por onde; lastro para: A trace to know the path; a grounding to know why.
text.Camada transversal de jurimetria, evidên: Cross-cutting layer of jurimetrics, operational evidence, and data and indicator auditing.
text.Data Despacho − Data Envio, média dos vo: Order Date − Submission Date, average for opinions
text.Intervalo inclui fila da unidade e tempo: The interval includes the unit’s queue and working time; it does not measure individual performance.
text.Data Despacho − Data Envio, média dos nã: Order Date − Submission Date, average for non-opinions
text.264 processos enquadrados na Resolução +: 264 cases falling under the Resolution + 256 referred for dismissal
text.Saneamento por extinção não equivale, po: Clean-up by dismissal does not, by itself, amount to the case being definitively closed.
text.mediana de duracao_min nas 17 rodadas; m: median of duracao_min across the 17 rounds; mean of 12.2 min

text.Tempo de máquina, não tempo humano. Depe: Machine time, not human time. It depends on the models’ infrastructure.

text.do início do crivo ao registro da decisã: from the start of screening to the recorded decision on the doubt
text.Cada dúvida é sustentada, contestada e d: Each doubt is argued for, contested, and decided before it becomes a question.
text.soma de perguntas; 218 dúvidas formadas,: sum of questions; 218 doubts formed, 11 dismissed
text.dúvidas mantidas sobre o mesmo ponto se: doubts upheld on the same point are consolidated into one question
A count of questions, not of hits.

text.falha técnica encerra a rodada inteira,: a technical failure ends the whole round, with no partial report
text.Três falhas de provedor (prazo de 120 s): Three provider failures (120 s timeout) and one cancellation.
text.7 no ponto corrigido + 2 em outro ponto: 7 on the corrected point + 2 on another corroborated point
text.12 atos no teste, de 18 selecionados: 12 rulings in the test, out of 18 selected
text.embargos de declaração acolhidos como re: granted motions for clarification as an external reference
text.Seleção exploratória, conferência pelo a: Exploratory selection, checked by the author. Not a precision rate.
text.soma de cobertura nos 12 atos do teste =: sum of coverage across the 12 test rulings = 2.15
text.fração de parágrafos com pergunta em cad: share of paragraphs with a question in each ruling
text.Supõe o vício num só parágrafo; com três: Assumes the defect sits in a single paragraph; with three paragraphs, the expected value rises to 5.0.
